description: A 2HP label for marking out a section of a patch, carrying a line of text and an arrow pointing at what it names
notes: click the text on the panel and type to set the label, up to 38 characters. Click the arrow to cycle it between right, none and left. Both are saved with the patch
menu: Label (maximum 38 characters) — a text field holding the same label the panel shows
None — under the Top arrow heading, draws no arrow
Left — under the Top arrow heading, points the arrow to the left
Right — under the Top arrow heading, points the arrow to the right
